Smoothness — Slider 1-20

Target Part — Head / HumanoidRootPart / UpperTorso

Show FOV Circle — Visual FOV ring toggle

Aimbot Mode — Legit / Rage (bugged)

Aim Shake — Slider 0-10

Range Multiplier — Slider 2-8

Hitbox Transparency — Slider 0-100

Noclip — Walk through walls

Infinite Jump — Spam jump

Speed Boost — Slider 1-5

Jump Boost — Slider 1-5

Refresh Character — Button

Reset Character — Button

Spawn Jump — Button

Teleport to Nearest Enemy — Button (keybind: T)

Visuals Tab
Team Check (All Features) — Toggle

ESP Highlight — Toggle

ESP Names — Toggle

ESP Distance — Toggle

ESP Health — Toggle

Enemy Label — Toggle

Weapon ESP — Toggle

ESP Rainbow — Toggle

ESP Opacity — Slider 0-100

Tracers — Toggle

Tracer Origin — Bottom / Center

Box ESP — Toggle

Box Style — Corners / Full

Off-screen Indicators — Toggle

Set Player Color — Color picker button

Set Team Color — Color picker button

Hitbox Viewer — Toggle (wireframe overlay)

Fullbright — Toggle

No Fog — Toggle

Night Mode — Toggle

No Particles — Toggle

Crosshair — Toggle

Stats Tab
Session Stats — Kills, Deaths, KDR, FPS, Ping, Session Time

Reset Stats — Button

Interface Tab
Theme — 10 themes (Midnight, Cyberpunk, Ocean, Emerald, Sunset, Frost, Blood, Neon, Sakura, Void)

Rainbow Accent — Toggle

Rainbow Speed — Slider 1-10

Compact Mode — Smaller UI elements

Show Array List — Toggle

Array Shimmer — Toggle

Config Tab
Profiles — Save/Load/Delete/Reset named profiles

Profile list — Scrollable list of saved profiles

Keybinds Info — Shows all keybinds

Exit Hub — Button (saves profiles + cleans up)

System
Auto-save on exit — Profiles persist per Roblox username

Old profile migration — Auto-detects old generic profiles

Command bar — ; key — commands: /noclip, /fullbright, /hitrange

Minimize — Right Control

Show/Hide Hub — K key
